title-group.article-title: Home blood pressure monitoring protocol (test article)

sec.title: Background
sec.p: Home blood pressure readings taken in the morning and evening predict cardiovascular outcomes better than office readings.

sec.title: Methods
sec.p: Participants measured twice in the morning within one hour of waking and twice before bed, seated after two minutes of rest.

sec.title: Introduction
sec.p: Hypertension is common in older adults. Home monitoring allows a seven day mean to be computed.

sec.title: Thresholds
sec.p: A home mean of 135/85 mmHg or higher defines home hypertension in the guideline.

sec.title: Discussion
sec.p: Morning hypertension is an independent risk factor for stroke.
